items.item: bone-in chicken (thighs, drumsticks, or a combination)

instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the honey, soy sauce, olive oil, minced garlic, ketchup, paprika, and black pepper.
Arrange the chicken in a baking dish. Pour the sauce over the chicken and turn the pieces to coat well.
Bake uncovered for 45–60 minutes, depending on the size of the pieces, basting once or twice with the pan sauce if desired.
Check the thickest part of each piece with a food thermometer, avoiding the bone. Chicken must reach at least 165°F; thighs and drumsticks are often more tender around 175–185°F.
If you'd like a stickier, more caramelized finish, broil for 1–3 minutes at the end, watching closely so the honey doesn't burn.
Let rest for 5 minutes, then spoon some of the pan sauce over the chicken before serving.
notes: Easy oven-baked chicken thighs and drumsticks in a honey garlic sauce. Serve with roasted potatoes, rice, or steamed vegetables. For a toddler, shred the cooked chicken and carefully remove all bones and cartilage before serving.

tips.text: Check that your soy sauce, ketchup, and other packaged ingredients are certified kosher.
tips.title: Keep it kosher
